elements.description:
Activity by hour, a clock per day: an AM ring and a PM ring of hour segments shaded by how busy each hour was, with
the day in the middle and an hour's value there on hover or focus.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the grid's name

properties.name: days
properties.description: The days, a clock each, in the order given

properties.name: max
properties.description: The value that shades a segment fully; by default the busiest hour across every day shown

properties.name: levels
properties.description: How many shades, counting empty: 5 is empty and four steps of activity

properties.name: unit
properties.description: What the values count, after the number: "12 events"

properties.name: format
properties.description: Writes a value in full, e.g. (v) => `${v} min active`; replaces the number and `unit`

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The selected hour. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for day names and numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: An hour was selected or cleared ({ selected, value }: ActivitySelectedChange); cancelable – prevented, `selected` stays as it was

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the grid's name

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected hour – controlled when given (null for none)

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The hour selected on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.type: (selected: ActivityHourRef | null, value?: number | null) => void
props.description: An hour was selected or cleared; `value` is its value (null when it has no data)

changelog: **`tc-activity-clock`:** activity by hour, a clock per day. - **Rings:** an inner AM ring and an outer PM ring of twelve hour segments, labelled at 12 o'clock, with 12 at the top. - **Shading:** each segment shaded by its value in `levels` steps, scaled to the busiest hour shown or `max`. An hour with no data is outlined, not shaded. - **Middle:** the weekday and date, or the hour under the pointer or focus and its value. - **Header and selection:** the busiest hour in the header, and a selected hour reported with a cancelable `tc-selected-change`. - **Keyboard:** a grid with a row per day; ← → move an hour, ↑ ↓ a day, Page keys switch between AM and PM.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
